semanticProof.assumptions: Standard native RegExp/String/JSON/Array/Buffer behavior; primitive builtin call-count parity is not claimed.
semanticProof.capsAndCoercion: The original raw Buffer.byteLength(value)<=limit and STOP_STRING_CAP line executes first. No new limit comparison or coercion is inserted. Cumulative add and key-budget comparisons retain their original positions and rendered-token size.
semanticProof.classifier: Non-global character class rejects U+0000..U+001F, U+0022, U+005C, U+0080..U+FFFF. Its negated test accepts exactly all-code-unit sequences from U+0020..U+007F except quote/backslash, including the empty sequence.
semanticProof.fallback: C0, quote, backslash, all nonASCII, valid astral pairs and lone surrogates reach the byte-identical native JSON.stringify and rendered Buffer.byteLength fallback.
semanticProof.fastPath: Eligible code units need no native JSON escaping and each is one UTF8 byte. Native token is two quotes surrounding unchanged value, with byte count value.length+2. Slash and DEL remain eligible.
semanticProof.preserved: No cache, clone, source mutation, container serialization, new Proxy, global state, key-budget/cap/chunk/default-budget or traversal change. Existing4096-token/65536-byte thresholds and16MiB default are unchanged.
semanticProof.sourceReads: stringToken receives an already-read primitive string/key. No original source traversal, getter/trap call, array length read or property read is edited.

wholeByteRestoration.method: Apply generated unified forward/inverse hunks to pinned bytes in memory using Python; assert exact source/context/count matches. No JavaScript evaluation.
